description: SEC 13D/13G ownership stakes — Who owns 5%+ of a company, and who just crossed it: structured Schedule 13D (activist-capable) and 13G (passive) filings from SEC EDGAR. All params optional: ticker= or cik= (issuer or holder), holder= (name phrase, e.g. Icahn), form=13d|13g|all (default 13d), days= (default 14, or 365 with a ticker), limit=1-20, min_pct=. Each filing: issuer + ticker, every reporting person with shares, percent of class, voting power and type, event date, amendment flag, exit below 5%, Item 4 purpose excerpt, funds source, 13G rule, and a keyword stance ACTIVIST / ENGAGED / INVESTMENT / PASSIVE with the signals found (director nominations, proxy solicitation, strategic alternatives, take-private...). Summary: counts by form and stance, new stakes, exits, activist list, top holders. Public-domain SEC data. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_ownership_stakes
